correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no transform suffix (xfm conventions are not in the schema).

brainlife.desc: Linear and non-linear transform: affine.txt plus warp.nii.gz and inverse-warp.nii.gz displacement fields (FSL or ANTs).
brainlife.name: neuro/transform/nifti

original.desc: Linear & Non-Linear Image Warping in FSL format (warp.nii.gz / inverse-warp.nii.gz)

brainlife.readme:
Roughly based on https://docs.google.com/document/d/11gCzXOPUbYyuQx8fErtMO9tnOKC3kTWiL9axWkkILNE/edit

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.transform.nifti.json

files.desc: Both linear and non-linear transform should at least have affine.txt. We are currently setting this optional for older Apps that are yet to generate affine.txt. In the future, affine.txt will be the only required file.

governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
